report_comment.text: TCF3 encodes E2A transcription factors required for lymphoid development. PBX1 encodes a homeobox transcription factor that cooperates with other developmental regulators. TCF3::PBX1 defines a recurrent pediatric B-ALL subgroup documented by genomic profiling in a large patient cohort. In the St. Jude cohort, TCF3::PBX1-positive B-ALL had event-free survival comparable to other B-cell-precursor ALL but a higher incidence of CNS relapse. The CNS association persisted in the study multivariable analyses.
